description: Railway information systems organization responsible for IT systems supporting Indian Railways operations.
notes: Purpose: Represents CRIS as the railway information systems organization within the provider registry. Intended use: Official source for IT-systems-derived railway datasets (e.g. reservation, tracking, or systems data) once configured. Future configuration: API endpoint(s), authentication details, and dataset/resource identifiers must be added manually during Stage 3B.2. Manual certification required: This provider must be manually reviewed and verified against official CRIS sources before it can be marked verified or used for live data collection. No URLs, endpoints, or dataset IDs have been invented or pre-filled.
